title: Module 5 Presentation Studio
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting module 5 presentation studio to presentation storyboard with audience constraint and slide-level evidence, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Sequence and integrate the six presentation layers (purpose, structure, media, narration, citation, accessibility) in dependency order, justifying why each check must precede or follow another
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision when running the layered checks on a finished deck
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
